Bill.BriefDescription: Extending the restriction on local government taxation of internet services.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the taxation of internet services; and amendingRCW 35.21.717.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.21.717 and 2002 c 181 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Until July 1, ((2004)) 2006, a city or town may not impose any newtaxes or fees specific to internet service providers. A city or townmay tax internet service providers under generally applicable businesstaxes or fees, at a rate not to exceed the rate applied to a generalservice classification. For the purposes of this section, "internetservice" has the same meaning as in RCW 82.04.297.
